changelog: New: Build tab — MTGA-style deckbuilder with card search, filters (colors, CMC, types, format legality, rarity, price ceiling), +/- quantity controls grouped by type, and live stats (mana curve, land/creature counts, pip count, format validity)
New: Free-tier preview of the builder — free users can search, filter, and build full decks; Save is Pro-gated with a modal that preserves your draft
New: Draft autosave — your in-progress deck is persisted to ~/.densa-deck/drafts.json every few seconds so a crash mid-build doesn't lose work
Prior: Opt-in card database auto-update + what-changed modal (shipped in v0.1.7)
